title: Procedural 3D Gears with Rust, wgpu, and WebGPU
description: Build and animate procedural 3D gears with Rust, wgpu, and WebGPU. Learn indexed mesh generation, per-object uniforms, depth testing, and WGSL lighting.
imageAlt: Red, green, and blue toothed 3D gears with lit front faces and side walls on a black WebGPU canvas.
